tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Confirmed by CNBC: A Saudi national OpenAI employee was arrested after a sophisticated recording device was planted in an office, with no data breach reported.
Confirmed by The Guardian: Anthropic warns artificial intelligence models are months away from self-replication on smart devices, posing risks to home and infrastructure.
Confirmed by TechCrunch: A judge ordered OpenAI to turn over hiring records from former Apple employees in an Apple trade secrets case, but denied access to specific R&D areas.
Reported by Tech Guide: Apple unveiled HomeView, a new smart hub with a 7-inch display, Face ID, and Apple Intelligence.
Confirmed by BigGo Finance: Workday partnered with Anthropic to make the HR and finance agent Sana available within Claude, with general availability in late 2026.
Free every hour.
